  • Engine,producer: A page cannot grow a render's script record or its log without end (6e6e7e013d, #8854).
  • Parsers: Find ffmpeg and ffprobe from worker threads on Windows (a3e0903763, #8851).

Internal

  • Lint: Bound lint growth by counted string work, not a busy runner's clock (f8e4124273, #8858).

item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.95

Released on 2026-11-25.

Studio opens a project without waiting on a slow drive, and a sealed preview keeps its timeline and selection box after a reload. Edits are written only to the file Studio mounted and only to HTML, and a file's markup can no longer steer them.

Features

  • Studio: A sealed preview reports the shown display of every element a selector matches (8008dc89f0, #8757).

Fixes

  • Core: Strip file marks inside templates and refuse markup a browser reads differently (81869faaa7, #8845).
  • Studio: An edit goes to the file a host was mounted from, never one its markup names (9dc416ad50, #8844).
  • Studio Server: Element and animation edits take an HTML file only (92d0210a17, #8843).
  • Media Use: A music job puts its track at the name only when complete, and leaves the earlier one until then (5dd0ee9eff, #8841).
  • Studio: A file is a composition only when a browser would build an element carrying data-composition-id (d494f25c7b, #8831).
  • Media Use: Audio scripts replace the file at a name and leave a link's target alone (4c0d6148a3, #8830).
  • Studio Server: Opening a project no longer waits on its drive to answer a write (7359dc95e4, #8833).
  • Core: A timing observer firing after its page is gone no longer throws and fails the run (eff291db85, #8834).
  • Studio: A clip deleted while the preview reloads leaves the frame on screen (7d7378be02, #8819).
  • Studio: A file's markup cannot choose which file an element's edits are written to (56ba601bf1, #8812).
  • Studio: A corner resize saves the same position whether or not the preview is sealed (90f14d06f6, #8824).
  • Engine: A render keeps a fixed amount of the page's warning text and script addresses (e54c43503d, #8821).
  • Player: An unsealed preview whose runtime fails shows the failure and Retry, as sealed does (a8f06b76d7, #8808).
  • Studio: The text toolbar's colour swatch shows a colour set by the stylesheet (ed2a55ce5a, #8813).
  • Studio: A sealed preview's timeline keeps its clips bound to their elements through a reload (6d4102d1f1, #8817).
  • Studio: A sealed preview's selection box comes back after the preview reloads (abfc06d3c4, #8816).
  • Engine,cli,producer: Ffmpeg reading project media runs from an empty folder (e1e9bb822a, #8832).
  • Engine: Playlist walk treats entries ffmpeg opens verbatim as leaving the folder (3953e2dffc, #8827).

Docs & Examples

  • The menu and footer link the blog and tools pages on hyperframes.studio (8f28ec16d2, #8839).
  • README: Clicking the hero clip plays the film instead of downloading the app (22f268e2dd, #8835).

Internal

  • Studio: The edit bench reads a nudge burst's box once a sealed preview has drawn it (b79fd6ae2a, #8822).
  • Engine: The cut audio link test cuts the read under load too (6f997837c0, #8825).
  • Lint: Linear-time checks alternate their two page sizes so a busy runner slows both (26b9e902e5, #8837).
  • Studio Server: History prune tests no longer race the prune a history open starts (1563a9abd0, #8829).
  • Studio: The edit bench re-reads a waiting box that Studio remounts after a replay (47e6307efa, #8807).
  • Studio: A slow frame no longer splits the edit bench's nudge burst into two saves (1706711f91, #8809).

Full changelog

item.title: v0.9.94
item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.94

Released on 2026-11-25.

You can render one part of a film in a single pass, in any format and frame rate, with HDR video and shader transitions. Project files, media paths and captured videos stay inside the project, and code that reads media input options by position works again.

Features

  • Studio Server: The render route renders a part of the film when asked for a start and end (d2d527952, #8787).
  • Producer: Render a part of the film with HDR video or shader transitions (66aba4c7a, #8802).
  • Producer: Render a part of the film in one pass, in any format and frame rate (13ef667e6, #8794).

Fixes

  • Parsers: HTML a browser reads differently is refused before it is rewritten (4864ade28, #8760).
  • Studio: A sealed preview no longer shows the frame before the playhead after a save (b975bbed4, #8818).
  • Share: Exclude private paths from portable project files (44d49a521, #8804).
  • Studio: A sealed resize of a size-tweened layer saves a keyframe and stays where dropped (5f70c5e3b, #8799).
  • Studio: The preview opens only the project's compositions (df0297366, #8725).
  • Parsers: Callers that read mediaInputFormatArgs by position get the format list again (fb8e7eba9, #8806).
  • Parsers: Text in a title or textarea can no longer close it when a document is saved (d15883f30, #8805).
  • Engine: A page that keeps throwing looks up each error's throw site once, a few in all (7d9a14418, #8810).
  • Studio: Apply-to-scope writes only the grading attribute, exactly as given (14d582c0f, #8767).
  • Skills: Helper outputs replace a link at their name instead of writing through it (4920a939b, #8667).
  • Studio: A sealed empty box drags on the press right after its select click (614ece8bb, #8772).
  • Studio: The dev Studio serves project files only through its API (92e19cfd4, #8721).
  • Engine: Read only the host's own cgroup layout for memory and CPU limits (182716eaa, #8803).
  • Parsers: Media paths resolve to absolute paths, and only http(s) skip the literal-name check (3339cb8dd, #8740).
  • Player: A sealed player fails a cross-site film without the runtime as unsealed does (fbdfd188c, #8558).
  • Engine: Playlist walk judges an HLS list's segments as one stream (32618ac51, #8798).
  • Studio Server: Delete, cut, group and ungroup decline a script, style or page-shell target (2a03de9f1, #8801).
  • Studio: A sealed preview's timeline shows a composition nested in a sub-composition (6e7c35f3a, #8736).
  • Studio: A timeline delete takes its clips out of a sealed preview at once (02cef8e07, #8719).
  • Studio: An open text edit keeps its typing when a project file changes outside Studio (8c67cd536, #8690).
  • Sdk: A text edit never writes into a script, style or other non-content element (a9d967e1f, #8795).
  • CLI: Captured videos are saved only under a video name the tool chose (8f335ae59, #8750).
  • CLI: A whisper model is named by one plain file-name part, never a path or link (082d6f6ed, #8755).
  • Producer: Auto GPU mode measures its choice once per machine and reuses it (d55ecae30, #8788).
  • Engine: A render keeps and logs the page's console and error text only up to a fixed size (37b8f2647, #8727).
  • Producer: A private project file stays private under any path spelling (ff34919fb, #8786).
  • CLI: Capture checks the page's token result before using it (c7e19fdd2, #8766).
  • Studio: An element description keeps only a selector Studio would have built (32681eedc, #8789).

Internal

  • Deps: Bump vite to 6.4.6 (934de7b9b, #8815).
  • A PR author's own comment can carry the Studio and player captures (559ad7b6d, #8800).

Full changelog

item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.93

Released on 2026-11-25.

Telemetry turns off the same way everywhere with DO_NOT_TRACK or HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY, and a cached whisper model is used only when its checksum matches. Media commands and playlists read only local, self-contained inputs, and auto GPU mode picks software rendering when it is faster.

Fixes

  • Studio: Words selected in a sealed text edit show the formatting toolbar, as unsealed (d4edc6d14f, #8777).
  • CLI: A cached whisper model is used only once its sha256 matches its pin (5c4f5febbc, #8762).
  • CLI: DO_NOT_TRACK and HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY turn telemetry off the same way everywhere (20b020d192, #8781).
  • Producer: Auto GPU mode renders in software when software captures faster (c5ed60fc83, #8785).
  • Studio: Agent prompts keep composition values in quoted fields, after the person's request (25ad0d1f08, #8779).
  • Core: A sealed snapshot carries the tweens GSAP's global timeline runs (ab7f81c8a6, #8774).
  • Core: A colour-graded video no longer adds a stray row to the Studio timeline (b31b148f74, #8776).
  • CLI: Media commands read only local, self-contained inputs (4af0e9c09b, #8782).
  • Engine: Playlist walk refuses entries with no path and tagged lists (bf689be3ba, #8784).

Catalog

  • Engine: A registry or download refusal no longer says it was a capture (cb9dfa8f0c, #8791).

Internal

  • Player: The sealed media table counts only a load that changes crossorigin as the helper's (59bac900aa, #8773).
  • Studio: Soft reload wait rows stop failing on a slow Windows runner (77dbc72d74, #8778).
  • Studio: Preview walks read the frame Studio shows, not one Chrome re-lays out mid-shot (886e5d4f43, #8780).
  • Engine: Fit the engine size budget to the playlist folder walk (ab4d38d512, #8790).

Full changelog

item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.92

Released on 2026-11-24.

A Studio rename now names the files it left on the old path, and sealed previews save moves and resizes like unsealed ones. Renders no longer stop on a URL Node cannot parse, and local media, LUT paths and pasted edits stay where they belong.

Features

  • Core: A sealed preview answers a text toolbar's authored styles and fonts (36d576395, #8761).
  • Studio: Long audio keeps its fx and beats, read from the server, no page OOM (630409ca1, #8622).

Fixes

  • Lint: Audio_volume_tween_overrides_gain hint keeps the level the author set (ca64f8b5d, #8689).
  • Media Use: Accept CAF, W64, WavPack, AU and AC3 audio again (5a15b549b, #8716).
  • Studio: An element patch is declined when its target is a script, style or template (305686b31, #8764).
  • Studio: A GSAP read that throws still leaves the layer as it was (afd7469bc, #8759).
  • Studio: The rename note says to update the listed files by hand (3576301eb, #8763).
  • Producer: StartServer never listens without a token (2b1fe6f31, #8655).
  • Studio Server: Judge file writes as files, and refuse names that shadow a module (dd3f8440b, #8711).
  • Engine: Read ffconcat lists only as ffmpeg reads them (f7a3abcbe, #8714).
  • Studio: A timeline clip click asks the source about its layer once (7aec1af1a, #8752).
  • Core: A looped sound plays its whole slot in preview (7b78460d0, #8751).
  • Close the review notes on the stems record and the puppeteer-core lookup (179ebc101, #8702).
  • Studio: A rename names the files it left pointing at the old path (ce3992eda, #8747).
  • Studio: A refused sealed press always puts the box back on the layer (b3da2cf58, #8735).
  • Studio: Timing edits patch the clip and the duration readout in a sealed preview (5db64b4ad, #8684).
  • Studio: A sealed move of a layer with a later scale or rotation saves as a CSS translate (efb540744, #8749).
  • Engine: A script URL Node cannot parse no longer stops the render (416d9e036, #8723).
  • Core: Check never looks at a media file outside the project (2e1294649, #8742).
  • Studio: A sealed drag the preview never answers is refused, not saved wrong (2ffa5aeaf, #8720).
  • Player: A sealed preview whose runtime fails shows the film's error at once (96ec31243, #8746).
  • Studio: A sealed scale resize no longer shows its old size for a frame after the drop (eae8504c2, #8616).
  • Media Use: Heygen-tts speaks the word after a lone -- as written (e8559178c, #8743).
  • Studio Server: File edits refuse a target outside the project and change nothing (ee4ecfd97, #8737).
  • CLI: Measure probe --normalize replaces a link at the output name (f041181eb, #8738).
  • Producer: A downloaded asset's local path is written into the page exactly as named (f2087431b, #8739).
  • Studio: A paste from another file cannot choose where its edits are written (673f4b57c, #8730).
  • Player: A sealed player's redirect to another site loads without a console error (bf07a78b6, #8733).
  • Core: A rich-text style value is written from its own tokens, not copied (4821e02f2, #8734).
  • Studio: A hand move in a sealed preview saves as the same CSS translate as unsealed (d44c847ca, #8731).
  • Engine: Local media inputs open with the file protocol only, and other schemes are refused (d975475cd, #8726).
  • Engine: A late image whose URL Node cannot parse no longer stops the render (5969cd2b4, #8728).
  • Share: A change-of-space journal counts only when this install sealed it (90e86ef38, #8687).
  • CLI: Grade-compare opens a grades file's LUT paths only inside the project (534607f46, #8724).
  • Skills: Media-use resolve shim runs only the CLI it is handed (df909c65d, #8674).

Performance

  • Parsers: Judge private paths in linear time (3865262ba, #8691).

Catalog

  • CLI: Add says why a project's registry was not read (b30aaa26d, #8754).
  • CLI: A received project's registry is fetched only from public addresses (c6307feea, #8683).
  • CLI: Registry add looks for a Node package in the folders a file is written to (2b11131be, #8722).

Internal

  • Sdk Playground: The element-list test no longer times out on a slow runner (9343044d6, #8753).

  • Studio: The timeline reads an empty clip list's rows from the document once (85953d178, #8741).

  • Studio: A waiting press says whether it waits on the frame or a save (d3c16bbe98, #8596).
  • Producer: A render's compile runs on its own thread and stops at a deadline (590617475f, #8611).
  • Studio: An unsealed recording on an empty timeline records up to the composition's end (4f863db6d7, #8606).
  • CLI: Read alpha from modern CSS colors (bb87da4536, #8624)
  • CLI: Give --json the failure text as typed for cloud commands (31be52d934, #8607).

  • Docs: The banner and top button point to HyperFrames Studio in the browser (80402d278a, #8619)
  • CLI: Count print calls whose value is not plainly the CLI's own (c03897fc11, #8608).

item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.82

Released on 2026-11-22.

A preview loads GSAP's motion path plugin from the page's own GSAP folder or the host's copy, so it works with no network. Sealed previews get more fixes, from sound and the keyboard to moves inside nested compositions.

Fixes

  • Producer: A render serves every GSAP the CLI ships, and its own when the CDN is blocked (8c9c94572, #8349).
  • Core: The motion path plugin loads from beside the page's own GSAP, never a CDN it did not name (80f45de33, #8523).
  • Producer: A film with many clips of one 4K video no longer freezes the render probe (4daeb78c3, #8284).
  • Studio: A sealed preview never keeps the keyboard, so no key it reports is acted on (196eff39e, #8521).
  • Studio: A turned layer's cropped box is the bounds of its cut corners (e5e360154, #8502).
  • Player: A sealed film is heard when its frame may not start sound (87fddbc1a, #8495).
  • Core: Pasted or written markup never carries a composition source from elsewhere (2425df5f4, #8520).
  • CLI: Pinned-file downloaders check the cache folder is private before reading or writing it (675e3a876, #8486).
  • Studio: Paste and duplicate check the file they write, after every edit to it (bd7a8402d, #8519).
  • CLI: Publish updates a committed project only when this machine linked the folder (886f609c4, #8487).
  • CLI: Print project file names in check's stderr notes as visible escapes (4202462ca, #8485).
  • Player: A late timeline from the old film no longer keeps a switched player ready (c19d98d9a, #8500).
  • Core: A sealed move inside a nested composition shows where it was dropped (ec9a3a8ef, #8517).
  • Studio Server: A page with thousands of script tags no longer stalls the preview (0bc7963ff, #8518).
  • Producer: A probe step's out-of-memory error keeps its words, so it still reads as memory (258a3cf4e, #8513).
  • CLI: Cloudrun and lambda say a usage error before loading their cloud SDK (fbd1cd4bc, #8510).
  • Core: A timeline whose labels throw no longer empties the clip list (5d4420fee, #8512).
  • Studio: Vitest exits when a project is open in the dev data folder (b3d37f948, #8514).
  • Studio: The viewport gate tells a virtualized timeline by its mounted rows, not its clips (dd7799037, #8511).
  • Studio: A cropped layer's outline is cut at the layer's own scale, sealed or not (2b1495f7a, #8496).
  • Core: A far clip whose source is swapped learns its new length (4a47c33ea, #8509).
  • Studio Server: Previewing a page with thousands of media files no longer stalls the app (f03233ab4, #8505).
  • Producer: A render that stops while preparing names the step it stopped in (852611378, #8506).

Internal

  • CLI: The diagnostic test's ffmpeg stand-in answers the demuxer listing, writing no file (f38a4e367, #8515).
  • Studio: A failed walk in the viewport gate job names itself on the check (086948766, #8516).
  • CLI: The sign-in return test waits for each window's navigation instead of one second (20a91dd5f, #8507).

item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.78

Released on 2026-11-21.

Undo after an agent step now brings back the files it changed. A catalog gap report on Windows never puts a query your shell would run into a command, and renders sharing one capture proxy keep their connections.

Features

  • Engine: A late image's load time is logged when it arrives (e65b11e5c, #8372).

Fixes

  • CLI: Show control characters as text in notices that repeat a failure reason (c75860ddf, #8387).
  • Core: A Windows rename onto a folder that exists fails at once instead of waiting 1.3 s (7cb548e45, #8389).
  • Core: Show text direction marks and typed text as visible text in printed lines (f01d1f32b, #8384).
  • Studio Server: History keeps undo steps in order when file times and its clock disagree (63e700de1, #8383).
  • Core: A long text's name is cut at a word, not inside one (19587337f, #8388).
  • CLI: Check reports its own deadlines as check_deadline (d78e9a5f3, #8378).
  • CLI: Windows kills end only the process the CLI started, never a reused pid (93f2fcca4, #8382).
  • Player: Stop the preview reloading itself after a quick seek, and stalling at cuts on a slower connection (120689e3c, #8339).
  • CLI: Print check and validate setup commands on their own lines (88f7d4052, #8381).
  • Studio Server: The preview file check resolves links on volumes that refuse native realpath (40cc86252, #8377).
  • CLI: Print capture setup commands on their own lines (281f1a2a4, #8374).
  • Studio Server: An agent step waits for history's first copies, so undo brings old files back (fbbf5ee67, #8375).
  • Studio Server: History refusals carry a closed reason, so callers tell them from failures (d5881e8aa, #8376).
  • Studio Server: A timed-out history save says it may still land, so callers don't retry blindly (6b74cfa9f, #8300).
  • CLI: Read --json before the command name the same as after it (9a618b798, #8365).
  • CLI: Show control characters as text in capture, figma, usage and notice lines (7fcc4909b, #8366).
  • Studio: Adding or removing a text field keeps the spaces between words (e8f52dc86, #8369).
  • CLI: A received-files write waits out a held lock instead of failing on Windows (f74e1545c, #8367).
  • CLI: A stop reads the process tree from /proc on Linux, so load cannot hide a child (a2df08e49, #8363).
  • Engine: A capture proxy shared by many browsers no longer drops tunnels at 128 (5e16c18b1, #8362).
  • CLI: Show control characters as text in init, skills and render printed lines (8bc73a0bd, #8352).
  • CLI: Show control characters as text in more commands' printed lines (7a1163fc9, #8353).
  • Studio Server: A preview file request no longer waits on a silent drive on the event loop (7cb605c78, #8254).

Catalog

  • CLI: A catalog gap report hands back a line only when every shell reads the query as text (414557262, #8373).

Internal

  • CLI: The probe-cache snapshot test asks 16 times of an 8 s clip, not 40 of 20 s (c7a6c9315, #8390).
  • Lint: Linear scans are held to characters read and one coarse time bound (e0d844030, #8386).
  • Studio: The marquee-past-the-cap check waits as long as the frame takes to answer (b0d9f3615, #7757).
  • Studio Server: A held-file edit is checked for blocking waits, not wall-clock gaps (29a5003ee, #8236).
  • Studio Server: A held save proves it never sleeps the thread, not a 100 ms stall bound (ba81f6793, #8359).

Other Changes

  • CLI: The proxy fix and its Node.js 22.19 floor came out again before this release; they ship in v0.10.0 (296031974, #8311, 66156bf35, #8391).

item.description:

Released on 2026-11-19.

  • Core: Keep SVG selector alias growth within the compile budget (6bd0b5d87, #8238).
  • Lint: Read a media window's start through the parser (a7d7a6075, #8133).
  • Producer: Cancelling a render stops its compile (765883195, #8242).
  • Producer: Cap compile-time remote downloads, give them one deadline and stop them on cancel (77ea9d80c, #8195).
  • Core: Stop crashing on SVG elements named template (d106f9c8c, #8241).
  • Core: Read selector aliases only from what the compiler wrote (def770ed9, #8240).
  • Core: Page runtimes carry no wide characters, so pages stay one byte a char (01a5e948b, #8239).
  • Media Use: Re-freezing a recipe archives only under an integer version (e383abf47, #8201).

  • Player: Add customizable branding to the preview player (a9b4745f1, #7718).

  • Studio: Check every file a folder move or delete takes along (7ea012953, #8143).
  • Studio: A sealed preview takes its film's size from the player (d574ded1e, #7967).
  • Core: Keep the styles of a composition whose id contains $ patterns (12a2f83c4, #8141).
  • Compiler: Bound composition variable styles and variable media sources (c6e3f30be, #8144).
  • Core: A clip that stops downloading no longer holds the preview in Buffering forever (01331014d, #8138).
  • Player: Keep the video playing when you jump to another moment (3ee095bde, #7719).
  • CLI: Run global updates from the home directory (e99cd75b4, #8131).
  • Media Use: Escape control characters in the remaining resolve and cube-validate lines (9a096d72f, #8059).
  • Media: Keep each index.md row on one line and show control characters as escapes (ebddc4248, #8127).
  • CLI: Tests read opencv.js from a CI cache, never a CDN mid-test (e6cee094b, #7968).
  • Studio: Crop and scale resize work in a sealed preview (c569417bb, #8005).
  • Core: Treat files package managers run by default as tool-trusted (5f06e1b0a, #8129).
  • Skills: The launcher never starts a CLI older than its security floor (63c8f8ef6, #8125).
  • CLI: Say when check's face pass stopped a source at its time limit (59fbb22eb, #8122).
  • CLI: Media-use scripts read the host's kept record copy as the CLI does (c27adb35f, #8119).
  • Studio: Slideshow scenes, block stacking, drill-down and shortcuts work in a sealed preview (80bf6a9dd, #8118).
  • CLI: A rename keeps the received-files record listing the moved file (cb2b51525, #8112).

Docs & Examples

  • Ci: Say the npm-publish environment needs a reviewer's approval (d94aa5e30, #8123).

Internal

  • Producer: The missing-file render detail added in this cycle was taken out again before release, and returns in a later one (cfea8cfff, #7955, eb7dc14e8, #8146, 94d06663b, #8174).
  • Player: One hung Safari run no longer fails every Safari run after it (9acf26868, #8169).
  • Studio: Share one sealed preview frame that delivers messages like a browser (640cb3792, #8165).
  • Chrome: Pin chrome-headless-shell 158.0.8127.36 wherever the repo installs it (793052502, #8145).
  • Lint: Fail when a RegExp is built from text that is not escaped (dcdd34071, #8128).

HyperFrames v0.9.65

Released on 2026-11-17.

Studio's sealed preview now draws motion paths, reads keyframes and keeps a moved layer in place when you add a keyframe. Studio's error and analytics events no longer carry your error text, file paths or selectors.

Features

  • Studio Server: Let a host count the requests the API refuses with 403 (078e54d00, #8049).

Fixes

  • Studio: Error events send a class, a shape and Studio's own frames, not the error's words (195aa2f0c, #8114).

  • CLI: Check's face pass reads only media the page may load (c4a4167aa, #8116).
  • Studio: A sealed preview moves and saves a layer its animation moves (7a9d78e69, #8105).

  • Studio: A selected element stays drawn and draggable after a sealed preview reloads (1bf629c1d, #8081).
  • Studio: A click after two quick seeks adds the keyframe in a sealed preview (93622154e, #8103).
  • Release: List the MCP server as com.heygen/hyperframes, signed by heygen.com's key (88ba1b4d7, #8106).
  • Media Use: Audio scripts judge a received .env by the CLI's rule (bc5259d2d, #8086).
  • Media Use: Write local generator output into private per-run folders (ac33c1f2b, #8030).
  • Studio: GSAP keyframe and value reads work in a sealed preview (133965e4f, #8003).
  • CLI: Keep files received that a host's kept record still lists (183bf2a41, #8100).
  • CLI: Say a listed received file is gone, and drop a media file's line on rename (4a59fef2d, #8098).

Catalog

  • Watch the MCP registry hourly for HeyGen listings server.json never held (0b0108f2f, #8107).
  • Registry: Use the installed launcher in block guides (1c99314a6, #8101).

Internal

  • Github: Secret scanning skips the generated skills manifest (06578d941, #8115).
  • Studio: The GSAP reply check shares the frame record and handle checks (53a493edc, #8104).

Released on 2026-11-17.

Hover and thumbnail captures no longer wait on a 4K clip's preview copy. In a sealed preview, scrubbing plays the music track and timeline rows know their element. hyperframes check finds text over a face. Studio's proxy refuses requests with no same-site signal. A stable release now needs a second maintainer besides its approver.

Features

  • Studio: Timeline rows in a sealed preview know their element, source file and audio group (cda94eb0f, #8078).

  • CLI, Studio Server: Refuse ?hf-proxy when a request carries no same-site signal (4bea3e79c, #8066).
  • CLI: A project .env provider key prints a note when it is used (90de9b619, #8056).
  • CLI: Escape control characters in the media-use adopt skip line (2749aafb3, #8087).
  • Core, Lint, Parsers: Narrow the private-file rule for hidden files, build output and lint (f5ccfcc96, #7990).

  • Lint: Read a sub-composition mount's timing through the parser (c84c30fd8, #8037).
  • Core: Drop motion-blur state on __hfRuntimeTeardown (9797faea0, #7996).
  • CLI: Keep a deleted received page listed in the received-files record (e099c7d0c, #8090).

item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.63

Released on 2026-11-17.

Studio's sealed preview shows audio meters and audio groups, a layer reorder is one undo step again, and text films start sooner. No HyperFrames server serves a project file as a service worker's script. This release also carries every change listed for 0.9.62. That version never reached npm: the merge queue landed it in one push with another PR, and the publish read only the push's last commit. Since #8077 a release publishes from its own commit in the push.

Features

  • Core: The preview can stream an element's geometry to the editor every frame (f9c5ed07b, #8052).

Performance

  • Engine: Check still frames on several pages at once so text films start sooner (8ec97da01, #7997).
  • Producer: Frames start drawing while the audio mix finishes (0be1a0719, #7985).

Fixes

  • CLI, Producer, Inspector: Render, capture and inspector servers never serve a service worker's script (72925380c, #8073).
  • Studio: A layer reorder is one undo step again (df31ce2b1, #8072).
  • Studio: Audio meters and audio groups work in a sealed preview (93a4d29c0, #8011).
  • Studio: Adding a track no longer remounts every clip on the timeline (b064e40e1, #8068).
  • Studio Server: A project file is never served as a service worker's script (b4acc1a1d, #8064).
  • Studio: A service worker a project left behind is gone before a preview frame loads (7a0bec682, #8067).
  • Core: A held video picture is drawn through a VideoFrame closed after the draw (43e5b7cec, #7971).
  • Producer: Leave outside links out of site listings by default and warn SDK callers (fbb483852, #8065).

Internal

  • Publish: A release merged in one push with other PRs publishes at its own commit (9b565c8e0, #8077).
  • Publish: Publish to npm with the job's OIDC token, not a stored token (c106793f7, #8070).
  • Core: The reloaded-video playhead test builds a smaller film so busy CI never times it out (34f98e6a0, #8069).
  • Studio: The edit bench reads a sealed preview through its editing port (5f8b7a6ee, #8010).

Full changelog

item.title: v0.9.61
item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.61

Released on 2026-11-17.

Received projects and the files they reach stay inside their own folder across render, preview and Studio, and a sealed preview reloads in place in a fraction of a second. This release also carries every change listed for 0.9.60. That version never reached npm: its publish was refused because it ran from the release PR's merge ref, and since #8020 a stable release publishes from the push to main that merges it.

Features

  • Engine: Render telemetry says why a page cannot reuse still frames (c8df284b2, #7993).
  • Studio: An element's source-parsed animations are part of Studio's API (efc91fc87, #8061).
  • Producer: Enforce expected output dimensions before capture (8a13b2caf, #7871).

Fixes

  • Producer, Parsers: Render compile never looks for a scene's assets on another computer (524ea46bf, #8063).
  • CLI: Refuse media-proxy copies another site asks for in play and the static server (f97e28905, #8058).
  • Producer: Readers re-check outside-linked compositions, and the refusal names a step every surface can take (4721739ee, #8034).
  • CLI: Leave files from outside the project out of Lambda and Cloud Run site uploads (39347da9d, #8060).
  • CLI: A host can name projects whose received files are expected or all received (5ea86450a, #8025).
  • Core: Only Studio's own preview pages get the editing port, and undo sets only safe attributes (55291c00c, #8057).
  • Lint: Match a timed wrapper's close tag literally (3e01f691d, #8028).
  • Studio: Each drag shows as its own undo step once its save lands (647bdd4d7, #8033).
  • CLI: A refused reverse start reports whether HeyGen sent the refusal (53080581c, #8053).
  • Producer: Cap a render's total sub-composition expansion (b29e40d70, #8045).
  • Inspector: The inspector's Chrome starts as root or in a container (f91bbf0da, #8050).
  • Refuse media paths that ffmpeg's image2 demuxer would read as a pattern (fe93f9cd4, #8047).
  • CLI: A project .env provider key gives way to the person's own credential (14c4e4c26, #8041).
  • CLI: Escape audio and media-use output, pin model files (c4439890c, #8013).
  • Producer: Keep the probe stage's media pre-checks linear in page size (e21f56dca, #8044).
  • Studio: Colour grading works in a sealed preview (d7d416124, #7999).
  • Engine: Bound the proxied host pre-check by the download's timeout (06b632017, #8048).
  • Engine: The GPU, host-ceiling and HDR launches keep the sandbox where the host allows it (7b27fbc84, #8038).
  • Studio Server: Cache reads never follow a link the project ships (70820b386, #8039).
  • Engine: Check proxied download hosts; keep raw GIF downloads private (5fcce21a6, #8040).
  • Skills: Locate.mjs reads the system font in place, not a shared /tmp copy (5b2990fc1, #8042).
  • Studio: Caption editing works in a sealed preview (915021265, #8002).
  • Producer: Cap the software encoder to the cores capture leaves free (f89f6d3d4, #8019).
  • Studio: A sealed preview's reload shows in a fraction of a second, not after 8 s (9daa7e876, #8015).
  • Skills: Run bundled TTS helpers from the skill folder, not the working directory (6115945cf, #8035).
  • A received-files record follows Studio renames, moves and deletes, and a nested record can't be moved out of reach (f5bb3e551, #7989).

HyperFrames v0.9.56

Released on 2026-11-16.

Studio's preview and the local servers now act only for their own pages. The CLI keeps its cache, history and restores inside the project. The arm64 Lambda image ships only the reviewed ffmpeg build, and large previews build faster.

Fixes

  • Studio Server: The composition file servers no longer serve credential or tool-state files (014326b40, #7889).
  • Studio Server: Lint and probe run only for requests from Studio's own pages (bbac8900e, #7894).
  • Studio Server: A history restore stays inside the project and uses only intact copies (478313ba0, #7902).
  • Studio: Take playback works for a preview its server made opaque (1e542956d, #7815).
  • Studio: The preview frame keeps the sandbox origin its host set (b650d0d19, #7886).
  • Studio: Present decks open only in their own site, and the preview reads only its own frame's messages (4067efc45, #7877).
  • Core: The runtime bridge checks each control message before acting on it (97d8f26e7, #7892).
  • CLI: render --docker keeps the host's page-network restriction inside the container (5d8605eb8, #7890).
  • CLI: preview --stop stops only the process the system reports holding the port (ace8a78dc, #7882).
  • CLI: The check cache is saved only as a project record, never through a linked file (7801e3ff3, #7884).
  • CLI: History turn ids read from the project folder are checked and sent encoded (6efa6b635, #7883).
  • CLI: Catch-up lists only the turns the app added after the hand-off (0f23f40f8, #7874).
  • CLI: A received-files record in a folder under the project counts for a render (1c159c550, #7900).
  • CLI: Media-use copies only the sound effects its bundled index names (ed93a1312, #7895).
  • Media Use: Local models start from a folder outside the project (756c2c6c1, #7888).
  • Engine: A cached browser is used only when its files match the pinned build (56a2d0c53, #7865).
  • Engine: Timeline frame predictions stay within the render's frames (f5a74a567, #7885).
